The biggest launch this week appears to be Meta's open-weight Muse Spark Open, but the sources are mostly aggregator trackers, so the dates and details below should be checked against the original announcements.

**Notable releases, October 12–18, 2026:**

- **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (Oct 17):** The newest release in the trackers. One roundup describes it as an in-place upgrade with stronger agent scores.
- **Muse Spark Open (Meta, Oct 15):** Meta's open-weight model, which it says "is the most capable US open-weight model to date". It has 816 billion parameters and a 1 million token context window, and runs on two Mac Studios with M5 Ultra chips. Note that one source says it requires at least 1 terabyte of RAM to run locally.
- **FLUX 3 Image Klein (Black Forest Labs, Oct 15):** A 5.6B open-weights model for text-to-image, editing and up to 10 reference images.
- **Grok Voice 3.0 (xAI, Oct 14):** The new speech-to-speech model in xAI's Voice Agent API.
- **Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full (Meta, Oct 12):** Meta describes these as its new frontier models for personal and professional AI agents. Their key features are Active Memory and Active Focus. One analyst reports they scored 52 and 56 at max reasoning effort on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.
- **Fish Audio Drama 3 (Oct 13):** An open-weight 35B MoE text-to-speech model (3B active) that supports 83 languages.
- **Others:** Jev 1.14 from TypeSafe AI (Oct 14), NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, and Tencent's Hy-Memory-30B-A3B, which trackers list as released in the same window.

**Caveats:** The trackers disagree on details. One lists Muse Wonder on Oct 12 and another says it was Tuesday 13th October. The "this week" lists also include models from just before the window, such as Microsoft-Decision-1 and Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo from Oct 9. For confirmed dates and specs, check the developers' official announcements.

Based on the search results, Gemini 4 Argon appears to have reached general availability on October 13, 2026, though the sources are mostly secondary and I couldn't confirm the claim from Google's own announcement.

**Most recent reports (October 13):** One report says Gemini 4 Argon is now available to developers and enterprises through the Gemini API, AI Studio and the Gemini platform. Another describes Argon as GA as of 13 Oct 2026, with the Gemini API changelog recording the same day as general availability for model id gemini-4-argon. Consumer access is more limited: one report says the model is rolling out in the Gemini app for Google AI Pro and AI Ultra subscribers.

**Pricing:** Introductory API pricing is $2/$10 per million tokens through 30 Nov 2026, then $4/$20.

**Earlier status (late September to early October):** Access was initially narrow. Argon was officially announced on September 30, 2026, and began a limited rollout to trusted cybersecurity defenders through Google's Fairwind Program. As of October 5, one report said there is still no confirmed general-public release date, so these reports predate the October 13 update.

**Caveats:** The October 13 reports come from third-party sites (letsdatascience, toolhalla), and some of the pricing and access details differ between sources. One source notes that Google's benchmark and capability claims are vendor-reported and should be validated against a team's own workload. If you need this for a decision, check Google's official blog post and the Gemini API changelog directly.

Links: [{"title":"Meta Enters AI Frontier With New “Wonder” Models","url":"https://propakistani.pk/2026/10/13/meta-enters-ai-frontier-with-new-wonder-models/"},{"title":"Meta releases Muse Wonder, its first frontier-class AI model","url":"https://aiweekly.co/alerts/meta-releases-muse-wonder-its-first-frontier-class-ai-model"},{"title":"Meta Enters AI Frontier With New “Wonder” Models","url":"https://propakistani.pk/2026/10/13/meta-enters-ai-frontier-with-new-wonder-models/amp/"},{"title":"Image Credits:Meta","url":"https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/12/meta-releases-its-first-frontier-model-muse-wonder"},{"title":"Image Credits:Meta","url":"https://techcrunch.com/?p=3176752"},{"title":"Muse Wonder puts Meta back in the AI race with frontier models","url":"https://yourstory.com/ai-story/muse-wonder-meta-ai-race-frontier-models"},{"title":"meta muse wonder memory agent models","url":"https://interestingengineering.com/ai-robotics/meta-muse-wonder-memory-agent-models"},{"title":"www.mobileworldlive.com","url":"https://www.mobileworldlive.com/?p=515520"},{"title":"Meta revient dans la course aux modèles frontière avec Muse Wonder","url":"https://next.ink/261349/meta-revient-dans-la-course-aux-modeles-frontiere-avec-muse-wonder/"},{"title":"Meta logo with figures in front","url":"https://www.vktr.com/ai-news/meta-debuts-muse-wonder-frontier-ai-agent-models/"}]

Meta's Muse Wonder is a frontier model pair, and Active Memory is one of its two headline features. Meta describes Active Memory as keeping relevant user information across conversations. One of Muse Wonder's key features is Active Memory, which allows the model to retain important details across conversations and bring them back when relevant. A personal assistant could, for instance, remember a user's preferences, project details or earlier instructions instead of treating every conversation as a fresh start.

**The launch:** Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on October 12, 2026. Meta's Superintelligence Lab released a pair of new state-of-the-art models on Monday, representing the company's first attempt at a frontier model. Meta says that Wonder and Wonder Full achieve comparable benchmark scores to Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra, according to its model card.

**Active Memory and Active Focus:** The two features are marketed together. The first carries context across sessions; the second is meant to keep multi-step agents from drifting as they navigate between apps. Active Focus is described as helping the model persist with difficult tasks, try alternative approaches when it gets stuck and ask for clarification when needed.

**Access and pricing:** Muse Wonder lists at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens on the Meta Model API. Muse Wonder Full is restricted to Muse Code subscribers at $50 per month for the Power tier and $200 per month for the Maximum tier.

**Caveats:**
- Meta's memory claims rest largely on its own numbers. Meta says Wonder scores higher on MemoryBench than Fable, Opus, or Astra, though the launch materials do not publish the raw per-benchmark numbers behind that claim.
- A French report notes that Meta uses a marketing name for a function built into all competing models. Meta claims superior efficiency, though: on an internal benchmark, Muse Wonder scores 85.6%, against 81.5% for Opus 5.5 or 81.4% for GPT-6 Astra.
- Independent comparisons are less favorable on some tasks. Wonder Full looks strongest on long autonomous coding and document-heavy agent tasks in Meta's testing, while Claude Opus 5.5 still leads the main independent index and several general benchmarks.

1. **Meta Muse Wonder / Wonder Full (10월 12일)**: Meta Superintelligence Lab의 첫 프런티어급 모델로, 대화가 바뀌어도 사용자 정보를 기억하는 'Active Memory'와 여러 단계의 에이전트 작업에서 방향을 잃지 않게 돕는 'Active Focus'를 핵심 기능으로 내세웠습니다.
   출처: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/12/meta-releases-its-first-frontier-model-muse-wonder)

2. **Google Gemini 4 Argon 일반 공개(GA) (10월 13일)**: 9월 30일 발표 후 일부 사이버 보안 담당자에게만 열려 있던 구글의 최신 프런티어 모델이 Gemini API, AI Studio, Gemini 앱(AI Pro·Ultra 구독자)으로 공개 범위를 넓혔습니다.
   출처: [Let's Data Science](https://letsdatascience.com/news/google-releases-gemini-4-argon-for-scientific-computing-644a49ff)

3. **Meta Muse Spark Open (10월 15일)**: Meta가 "미국에서 가장 뛰어난 오픈 웨이트 모델"이라고 소개한 코딩·에이전트용 모델로, 가중치를 무료로 받을 수 있고 Apple과 협력해 Mac Studio 두 대에서 로컬로 돌릴 수 있습니다.
   출처: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/15/meta-launches-an-open-weight-model-that-runs-on-macs/)

**참고**
- Gemini 4 Argon은 새 모델 출시가 아니라 공개 범위를 넓힌 것입니다. 또 날짜와 세부 내용은 제3자 매체 기사로만 확인했고, 구글 공식 발표문은 찾지 못했습니다.
- 이 기간에 나온 다른 모델로는 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash(10월 17일), xAI Grok Voice 3.0(10월 14일), Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 Image Klein(10월 15일)이 있습니다. 순위를 매길 때 DeepSeek을 3위 안에 넣을 수도 있습니다.
